quicklook.title: QuickLook
quicklook.fix: No action needed unless previews fail.

ok.detail: QuickLook is running (named pipe present); Space previews via it.
ok.fix: No action needed. Previewable file types depend on QuickLook plugins; a momentarily busy pipe falls back to Peek/built-in.

missing.detail: QuickLook is not running (named pipe absent; an installed-but-stopped QuickLook reads the same).
missing.fix: Start QuickLook to take over previews; for now Space tries Peek, then the built-in pane.

warn.detail: Could not determine QuickLook status (failed to resolve the current user SID).
warn.fix: Run in a normal user session; otherwise rely on Peek or the built-in preview.

unbridged.detail: A QuickLook process is running, but there is no named pipe AFM can bridge (AFM only speaks the classic QuickLook pipe protocol; the Store edition does not expose it).
unbridged.fix: No action needed: Space previews are served by PowerToys Peek (or the built-in pane). To have AFM drive QuickLook directly, install the classic poizan42 QuickLook.

list.body: Pick a group on the left to load its folders. Drag a group to change the order.

create.title: Create a Work Group
create.body: Type a name here and press Enter to start a new group. It stays empty until you add folders to it.

group.title: Switch groups
group.body: Click a group to make it active. Its folders appear in the details on the right. Click the highlighted group now.

header.title: What is a Project?
header.body: A Project holds the folders, links and tasks for one thing you are working on.

list.title: Your Projects
list.body: Select a project on the left to see its details. You can drag projects to reorder them.

create.title: Create a Project
create.body: Type a name here and press Enter. Then add the folders and tasks that belong to this piece of work.

group.title: Open a project
group.body: Click a project here to load its work directories and tasks. Click the highlighted project now.

gateway.title: Connect a service
gateway.body: Enter the service address here and save it. Use Refresh to check whether the connection works.

backends.title: Available locations
backends.body: These cards are the services you can browse. Click one to open its files like a local folder.

refresh.title: Check the connection
refresh.body: Click Refresh whenever a service looks unavailable. It only re-checks status and does not change your files. Click it now.

header.title: Optional AI features
header.body: This page only exists in AI builds. Core builds do not show AI options at all.

nav.title: Pick a section
nav.body: Each section on the left groups one AI capability and its settings.

panel.title: Read before you configure
panel.body: The description here explains what the selected capability does and which services it needs.
